notes: Fixes the Reload Caddy button on Stack Health, which failed on every press — it passed a flag that only the server's start command accepts, and would have skipped the reload as unnecessary even once that was fixed. Found while working out why the site blinked out a few times this afternoon: each hub update restarts it for about four seconds, and the reverse proxy was giving up instantly rather than waiting. It now waits, so hub updates should no longer take the login-gated sites down with them.
